items.title: Surface manual fallback warnings in recovery views
items.context: When story_get/session_brief sees initCheckAttestation=fallback, render clear language that this was manual fallback attestation, not independent reviewer approval, and that later PLAN/DEV/REVIEW/TEST gates remain required.
items.userSees: session_brief prints `INIT fallback warning` and says `manual fallback attestation, not independent reviewer approval`; story_get JSON includes initCheckAttestation=fallback and a continuation warning string.

happy.desc: A fallback story shown by session_brief includes an `INIT fallback warning` section and the phrase `manual fallback attestation, not independent reviewer approval`.

edge.desc: story_get for a fallback story still exposes initCheckAttestation=fallback and also exposes a continuation warning without changing independent story output.

adversarial.desc: The warning explicitly says later PLAN/DEV/REVIEW/TEST gates remain required and that implementation needs explicit user/project authorization.

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke asserts session_brief renders INIT fallback warning and the phrase manual fallback attestation, not independent reviewer approval.
Smoke asserts story_get exposes initCheckAttestation=fallback and initCheckFallbackWarning for fallback stories, while independent reviewer stories do not carry the warning field.
Smoke asserts fallback warnings state later PLAN/DEV/REVIEW/TEST gates remain required and explicit user/project authorization is needed for continuation.

items.title: Make init_check_repair output close with a continuation boundary
items.context: After init_check_repair succeeds, its human-facing output should explicitly say fallback repairs only INIT_CHECK and does not authorize implementation or replace later reviewers.
items.userSees: init_check_repair success output ends with `Fallback only repairs INIT_CHECK; it does not authorize implementation and does not replace later PLAN/DEV/REVIEW/TEST reviewers.`

happy.desc: Successful init_check_repair output contains the continuation-boundary sentence after the audit line.

edge.desc: Refused repair paths still write no init-check.json and do not emit a misleading continuation hint.

adversarial.desc: High/critical issue fallback still warns that INIT_CHECK gate blocks and still includes the no-implementation-authorization boundary.

items.title: Add smoke coverage for the fallback continuation guard
items.context: Extend or add focused smoke tests proving story_get exposes fallback, session_brief renders the manual fallback warning, and next-step wording includes the explicit-authorize-before-continuing boundary.
items.userSees: npm --prefix packages/main run test:init-check-fallback-smoke prints `✓ init check fallback/repair smoke passed` after asserting story_get warning, session_brief warning, and init_check_repair continuation boundary.

happy.desc: The focused fallback smoke test passes after build.

edge.desc: The smoke test asserts independent reviewer story_get does not carry fallback warning fields.

adversarial.desc: The smoke test fails if session_brief resumes a fallback story without the explicit authorization boundary.

auditLog.reason: Start fallback continuation guard smoke coverage.
Claude implementation committed; Codex re-ran build, fallback smoke, and scope contract. Recovery-view fallback warning coverage is proven by smoke assertions.
